messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: stan::services API, configuring via JSON
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to build a proof-of-concept for a way for Stan to provide a
service that would handle validating parameters (and setting defaults)
such that PyStan and RStan could use the service.

I was thinking that this might be possible if one added two methods to

stan/services/arguments/argument_parser

- int parse_args_json(std::string, std::ostream* out = 0, std::ostream* err = 0)
- std::string to_json() (since PyStan and RStan need a way of knowing about the values that are set)

Does this make sense as a strategy? Is anyone else working on this?

Also -- is the json based var_context used anywhere (json.hpp / json_data.hpp)?

Thanks,

Allen

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stan::services API, configuring via JSON
parts:
I was hoping Michael or Daniel would weigh in here. They've
put a lot of thought into this; see:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Stan-API-Refactor

To answer your last question, no, JSON's not used
anywhere. Mitzi and I built it assuming we'd add an option
to read data in JSON format, but nobody's seen it through (Mitzi
just got a new job that's keeping her busy and I'm working on
other things that seem higher priority).

- Bob
